domain.text: Documentation: added a lesson about Luna workers stopping without a status and escalation to sol.

impressions.text: The task was to document Luna stopping and escalation behavior, citing nine prior PRs as evidence.
The worker reported adding the lesson and a changelog fragment, with markdown, formatting, and diff checks passing.
An earlier CI run flagged the missing changelog fragment and its unsupported kind; the worker reports correcting both before CI passed.
The orchestrator noted that the base was stale and refreshed it before merging; it also reported the worker reached READY on the first run.
